summary: Both input strings always contain exactly four characters, so the two parity groups each have fixed size two and no legal scalable length axis exists for runtime tiers.

replacement_checks.evidence: The Accepted source extracts four fixed two-character slices, sorts each fixed pair, and performs two equality comparisons.
Authored cases cover zero operations, each parity swap alone, both swaps, duplicate characters, all-equal strings, and impossible cross-parity anagrams.
